tpm: Handle send+recv as a single descriptor chain During review of CL:1387655 we observed that it shouldn't be necessary for both vtpm_op_send and vtpm_op_recv to perform virtqueue kicks. It should be sufficient for vtpm_op_send to place both an output buffer and an input buffer on the virtio queue as a single descriptor chain, and perform a single kick that executes both operations. This requires a larger virtio queue because a single virtio buffer cannot be both read and written. BUG=chromium:911799 TEST=run TPM playground program inside crosvm Change-Id: I6822efc3318a3952f91f64904e0434d916beae97 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1465642 Commit-Ready: David Tolnay <dtolnay@chromium.org> Tested-by: David Tolnay <dtolnay@chromium.org> Tested-by: kokoro <noreply+kokoro@google.com> Reviewed-by: Zach Reizner <zachr@chromium.org>

Based on feedback from apronin: > Hm, long-term it may actually make sense to have software-tpm and > real-tpm-for-glinux as two separate run-time options and only enable > real-tpm-for-glinux for glinux. > > we want to protect guests from exploits, but we also want to limit > access to tpm for random guests. CHROMIUM: Fix Bluetooth controller event mask config during system suspend As part of CL:1383763, a few Bluetooth controller events were disabled on suspension, to prevent the system from waking up spuriously. This change is applying the same event mask change as in CL:1383763, but instead of overriding the entire set of events mask it selectively mask out or restores the required events during suspend and resume. In addition, the new Set Event Mask operation introduced in this change is using the BlueZ/NewBlue new suspend and resume infrastucture. As part of suspend/resume operations, BlueZ sends a new MGMT command to the kernel to mask out/restore BT specified events. For now the change in the stack is commented out until all kernels are updated with the change. Kerenl 4.4 change is in CL:1464385 The original change in CL:1383763 is not removed until the new mechanism is enabled. For more details on the Bluetooth/NewBlue suspend infra refer to CL:1454328 BUG=chromium:930973 TEST=suspend and resume of system and verify event mask is set properly by the kernel. Verify event mask HCI and MGMT messages in BTMON. Change-Id: Icc7ebfbb790478e6d3f7dbaf176437f148c74b4d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1466849 Commit-Ready: Yoni Shavit <yshavit@chromium.org> Tested-by: Yoni Shavit <yshavit@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org>
